description: Class representing a custom XML manager, which provides methods to manage custom XML parts in the document.

Add.description: Adds a new custom XML part to the XML manager.

params.description: The XML string to be added.
params.name: xml

GetAll.description: Returns all custom XML parts from the XML manager.

returns.description: An array of all custom XML parts.

GetById.description: Returns a custom XML part by its ID from the XML manager.

returns.description: The corresponding ApiCustomXmlPart object if found, or null if no match is found.

GetByNamespace.description: Returns custom XML parts by namespace from the XML manager.

params.description: The namespace of the XML parts.
params.name: namespace

returns.description: An array of ApiCustomXmlPart objects or null if no matching XML parts are found.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiCustomXmlParts class.

GetCount.description: Returns a number of custom XML parts in the XML manager.

returns.description: The number of custom XML parts.
